_comment: Every number that reaches a page comes from here, and every entry names the command that produced it and the exact world it was produced in. check.mjs re-derives each `derivable` entry against the real thing — the sibling checkout, the npm registry, the release assets — and exits non-zero on disagreement. build-site.mjs will not emit a page if any figure in the template has no entry here. A number cannot be typed onto this site by hand and survive.
